AI Overview
Jet ski racing is a high-speed motorsport featuring Personal Watercraft (PWC) competing on closed-loop oval lake or ocean courses, drag strips, and long-distance endurance races. 
YouTube
·CALAS WORLD
 +2
Real-Life Jet Ski Racing
Course Types: Rallies and sprint heats take place on oval lake courses (up to a mile long) with 10 to 12 riders per heat. Endurance marathons like the Mark Hahn Memorial Havasu 300 span 300 miles. Drag racing events like the FuelTech HydroDrags feature high-powered acceleration builds. 
YouTube
·joecartersyoutube
 +3
Safety Gear: Competitors must wear a DOT/SNELL-approved helmet, a U.S. Coast Guard-approved snug life vest, a back brace (mandatory for stand-up classes), and a wrist lanyard that kills the engine if the rider falls. 
RIVA Motorsports
Classes & Speeds: Riders are grouped by engine size and watercraft type (stand-up vs. runabout). Top drag-racing jet skis reach record speeds over 147 mph, while circuit and performance builds frequently exceed 100 to 110 mph. Major sanctioning bodies include the IJSBA and the Jet Ski World Series.

Online Jet Ski Racing Games
If you meant the browser and mobile arcade game Jetski Race:
Gameplay: You pilot a watercraft through coastal or river channels, dodge obstacles like docks and buoys, collect coins or turbo pads, and race against computer-controlled rivals.
Where to Play: The game is available to play free in web browsers on platforms like CrazyGames or via app stores.
